144002.description:
Silvia Lauren is the duchess of the Aswan estate and the wife of the bloodthirsty war addict, Duke Victor Aswan. She is also one-month pregnant with Victor’s first child. At least, that’s the facade she has created in order to secretly reside in the duke’s castle while he is away fighting in a war. But when Victor returns from battle much earlier than anticipated, Silvia fears that her intricate lies will all come to light. However, instead of throwing her out of his home right away, Victor decides to go along with her scheme and happily awaits the birth of his nonexistent child—and by happily, it’s more like threateningly. How long will Silvia be able to keep up with her lies and remain by the ruthless duke’s side?

(Source: Tappytoon)

144003.description:
Does the always-horny CEO just want attention? Tomoyuki Hara (20) just can't seem to find a job. "I'll work for anyone that'll hire me!" With those words, he becomes employed at the short-handed Aoki Design. While happy to be on the payroll, Masatsugu Aoki, the boss, puts him on edge, saying "Work hard or I'll kick you to the curb!" Newly employed and already in all sorts of trouble! The horny company president and the fresh-out-of-college boy who's cute as a squirrel share a back-and-forth romance filled with steamy love and plenty of laughs!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 発情オオカミ君愛を叫ぶ

144004.description:
One day, Akari Kurono, a very poor high school girl surviving on plain pasta and tap water, applies for a high-paying part-time job at a dubious occult store. Together with the mysterious store manager, Amenpine, and his occult-loving co-worker, Koyo Meiji, they are determined to capture the "Dark Nui," horrifying entities that threaten the human world!

Let's capture the "Dark Nui"!

(Source: MangaTime Kirara, translated)

title.native: ホレンテ島の魔法使い

144006.description:
Ji-o’s luck runs out when she gets injured before the tryouts for the national taekwondo team. In the middle of facing what seems to be the biggest crisis of her life, she meets Gyeol, a mysterious boy who changes her life forever. He’s the definition of a bad boy with a good heart, and she finds herself unable to resist his charms. However, she might be playing with fire as he’s someone who’s involved with the wrong crowd. Is falling for Gyeol worth the risk?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters. Seven extras are exclusive to the paperback edition.
synonyms: What I Decided to Die For

144007.description:
Kyotaro Inubushi, a moronic former yakuza, returns to his small home town after making a huge blunder against his own clan. He convinces his childhood friend to hide him in her apartment for a while. But when Kyotaro enters the flat, he discovers that a teenage girl is already living there. And she's none other than... his daughter, whom he has absolutely no memory of. Kyotaro will have to come to terms with this rebellious personality to (re)become the best father he can be, despite his explosive temperament, his gangster mentality and a group of dangerous individuals looking for him who have just arrived in town!

(Source: Omaké Books, translated)

144010.description:
The rewriting of history ended when Oscar and Tinasha destroyed the Elteria spellbook. The king and the witch are reunited in a history that can never be rewritten, and their love story comes to an end.

Oscar and Tinasha, who have escaped from the bounds of this world, are now entrusted with the mission of destroying the nine remaining spellbooks. The endless journey of the king and the witch, the repeating cycle of death and rebirth, begins again.

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

144011.description: “In 8 years, when you’re all 23, there will be a meteor shower that only happens once every thousand years. They say that if you make a wish on them, it will come true!” – and indeed 8 years after graduation the students got back together to climb the Hoshimi Mountains for the best view of the meteor shower. This reunion though is really not going as planned as all these long-lost friends have all their own secrets…

144012.description:
The sweet and innocent Princess Iris is deeply in love with the great wizard Master Zeno. Unfortunately, he's been turned into a cute little bunny rabbit due to a curse by the evil demon lord he defeated years ago. But, Iris doesn't care. A prince is asking her for her hand in marriage, and she knows this is her last chance to be with her beloved Master Zeno. After persuading the initially unwilling older wizard, he tells her to meet him in his office at night. When she gets there, Iris can't believe her eyes...
A delicious fantasy love story full of pure magic!

(Source: Renta!)

144013.description:
Sonogi, an employee at the host club "Eden," is in the biggest crisis of his life. He's woken up with female parts in addition to his male ones! After hearing that the number one host at the club, Kuroe, with his beautiful face, baritone voice, and relentlessly womanizing nature, went to med school, Sonogi tries confiding to him in private. Not only does Kuroe wildly misunderstand him, he's weirdly intrigued. Even after hearing Sonogi's story, he's still keen to "study" up on what's happening inside Sonogi's pants! A scary-faced, lovable psychopath toys with a vulnerable, shaved, and untouched new "girl" in this gender-bending romance!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Kuroe and the Garden of Feminine Pleasures

144016.description:
One day, Charlotte Bennett comes to study in Akito Aoyagi's class. With her neat and elegant demeanour and cute appearance, all his classmates are attracted to Charlotte, but Akito secretly feels that she lives in a different world and takes a step back from her.
However, Akito's daily life changes dramatically when he saves Charlotte's lost sister, Emma. The three of them play dominoes, sit around the dinner table and go out together. As they spend more time together, Akito and Charlotte grow closer, as gently as awkwardly.

The manga depicts the miracle-like encounter of the "DonGlees" boys. At the end of an adventure with friends that began during an unusual summer vacation, the boys arrive in Iceland—the land of flames and ice. What "treasure" have the boys found by looking at themselves and transcending the world...!

(Source: MAL News)

Xiao Xiao is a high-level F2P player. While he was playing the game, he jumped into the game world itself. He could just go on grinding levels? But it seems that our hero has other ideas? Why are you exploiting the economy instead of leveling? Hey, what kind of hero are you anyway?

After graduating from college, Su Ning worked as a courier for 99 days, which unlocked the Delivery Super System! Now he can win super prizes for completing deliveries!
"Ding! You just completed a special delivery, you win 10 million dollars!"
"Ding! You just completed a special delivery, you win a Lamborghini!"
"Ding! You just completed a special delivery, you win a meal at a three-star Michelin restaurant!"

144027.description:
“If there is a next life, I will save you.” Aria is the last remaining siren, a monster who bewitches humans with song. Shackled, she is forced to sing to nobles until she coughs blood. By the time the demonized Grand Duke Lloyd Valentine frees her, it’s too late. She has already breathed her last… or so she thinks. When she awakens in the past, Aria dedicates her life to protecting the duke, but she wonders if that’s really all her life is worth. Will she ever be free? Or is this siren destined to sing the same song forever?

(Source: Tapas)

One after another, elite Killing Names enter the field. What lies at the end of this deadly battle? The forefront of new youth entertainment is here!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

"It might not be bad to commence the Zerozaki."

The Zerozaki Clan is a family of demonic killers, ranked third among the Killing Names. Zerozaki Magashiki, known as "Girly Tastes (Bolt Keep)", senses a danger creeping up on the clan and finally appears on the stage. What will happen to the unity of the clan? The battle of the "sound user", Zerozaki Magashiki, begins now! The forefront of the new youth entertainment is here!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

144030.description:
The Zerozaki Clan is a family of demonic killers, ranked third among the Killing Names.
Zerozaki Hitoshiki, who attends junior high school with the name "Migiwame Toshiki", meets someone who claims to be his friend. The upcoming ace of the Niounomiya Performance Art Troupe, Niounomiya Izumu, ranked number one among the Killing Names. What "request" will come out of that mouth of his......?!

The Zerozaki Clan is a family of demonic killers, ranked third among the Killing Names.
Having just become siblings, Zerozaki Hitoshiki and Mutou Iori attack Aikawa Jun—Humanity's Strongest Contractor—with the best intentions. But, as a result, get caught up in her work! They're headed towards the domain of the second-ranked Killing Names, the Yamaguchi Folks, on the island of Taiyakujima. Therein lies the Lifelong Undefeated Crystal Kaiser, Rikka Kajumaru.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

144032.description:
The Zerozaki Clan is a family of demonic killers, ranked third among the Killing Names.
Zerozaki Hitoshiki, 17 years old, during Spring when he was freest and in his prime. The six Cursing Names, the counterparts to the seven Killing Names—the Tokinomiya Hospital, the Tsumiguchi Firm, the Nukumori Garden, the Shibuki Factory, the Kino Division, and the Toganagi Faction. Hitoshiki inevitably gets caught up in a battle between a messy alliance and his brother, Zerozaki Soushiki.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

144033.description:
The Zerozaki Clan is a family of demonic killers, ranked third among the Killing Names.
A boy with eyes like that of a dead man and a serial killer with a tattoo on his face. The story of their encounter and the never-before-told truth of the Kyoto serial killer case is finally revealed! The motivation of Zerozaki Hitoshiki, and its miserable ending......?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

144034.description:
Seo-Jun, who attends classes in the design department, refuses to drink with his friends and, on his way home, finds Min-Hyeon lying on the side of the road in the rain and takes him home to nurse him. Seo-Jun then meets Min-Hyeon, who wants to thank him, and falls in love at first sight...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

144035.description:
Im Jiun, a freshman, moves into a share house to have his own space, hoping for an average-looking roommate. But his new roommate, Jeong Suhyeon, is not only handsome and kind but also from a chaebol family—so rich that he owns the very share house Im Jiun is living in. As time passes, Im Jiun realizes that beneath Suhyeon’s sweet exterior lies an unpredictable side, and before he knows it, Suhyeon kisses him out of the blue! How will Jiun handle this chaos?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: รูมเมตรุ่นพี่ ขยี้หัวใจ

144036.description:
The daily life of a man who can understand his high-energy white pom.

(Source: comico, translated)

144037.description:
After food critic Ji-Ho’s first meeting with novelist In-Woo ends in disappointment, he vows never to work with him. That is until In-Woo offers to buy him dinner. It’s then that he learns that In-Woo is unable to experience one of life’s basic joys – taste – and needs someone to describe flavors to him for his next novel. The more they meet, the more Ji-Ho finds himself being drawn to In-Woo... but why? Is it because he too harbors a secret of his own?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

144038.description:
Dae-Ho has a crush on his friend 'Si-On' and decides to be courageous and confess to him, but Si-On sneers at Dae-Ho's confession, which leads to the start of a violent relationship

After being hurt by Si-On, Dae-Ho feels devastated by the book that encouraged him to confess... But right at that moment, a strange light emanates from the book and takes Dae-Ho to another world.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 extras.

144039.description:
The city’s most popular brothel ———Zui Xian Brothel, a place where all types of monsters and demons gather and where mortals get allured. The talented and calm beauty, Liu Siqing, was beaten by the coquettish newcomer, Ling Huyan, for the number one spot?

The fox demon and the green snake are fighting for the number one spot. Who will win in this battle, the calm and alluring green snake or the flirty and charming red fox? Who has the upperhand? And who is getting more and more into the battle?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

144040.description:
Ling Yufei, a commercial pilot, finally sees some hope of becoming the Captain. However, a sudden turn of events shattered his dream of becoming a Captain in a flash. To his surprise, the new Captain is younger than him! On top of that, he’s an ex-paratrooper!? And so, Ling Yufei is forced to operate the “Romantic Airline” together with his new “boss”.

What interesting stories will await us onboard? Fasten your seat belts, SkyHawk's Romantic Airline is about to take off…

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Rising to the Azure Sky - Let's Fly Together

144041.description:
Lee Junghyuk, an incubus, relies on vitality obtained through intimate encounters in people's dreams to survive. However, past trauma has left him emotionally numb, suffering from sexual anhedonia until he meets Yoo Seohee. Their chance encounter at a club leads to an unexpectedly fulfilling night together. Yet, as Junghyuk discovers Seohee's reputation as a notorious playboy at their university, he questions whether their connection can evolve beyond mere partners...

(Source: Lezhin)

144042.description:
Max, a now-former captain of the Royal Knights, went on the quest to slay the great monster Medusa. Unfortunately for Max, it ended in great failure, and he ended up being turned to stone. At first, everyone celebrated his great sacrifice, and his statue was placed in the center of the town square. However, after just one week, the town was ready to throw him away. That’s when Eden, an Elf from the mountains, steps in and decides to care for the frozen Max. Eden had always been cold and aloof to him, so what exactly are his intentions with this unexpected kindness…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 31 extra chapters.
synonyms: พิกเมเลียน
點石成愛 : 畢馬龍效應

144043.description:
Water God Ming Yao sacrifices his life for the lives of the three realms, yet becomes the servant of Jun Sheng, the Demon Lord after five hundred years. Does he live the rest of his life as a mere servant, or pretend to be meek and get his way up, using his strengths to return to the heavenly realm? His relationship with the Demon Lord in the past life never really ended, how does he cut off those shackles? What will be Ming Yao's future?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

144044.description:
A dangerous journey gave Gu Ming the chance to meet the warm light that once existed in his heart -- Li Shuo. But now known as Wei San, he has already lost all memories about Gu Ming and is now an assassin. Mutual destruction or mutual redemption await the two...

A world ravaged by a mysterious organization, and a chaotic city filled with violence and madness. For the sake of revenge, and for the sake of saving Li Shuo from a cruel fate, Gu Ming will have no hesitation, even if he has to fall into a deep swamp of darkness.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

It is 1866, the third year of King Go-Jong’s reign. It is also the second year Gyeom has been waiting for his lover, Jeong, who left to study literature. Finally, Jeong has come back after the two years. He tells Gyeom he can not afford to be happy in Joseon, and decides to leave for Qing (China)...

Lin and Zhan were best friends back at police academy, but after the fallout of a controversial case, they grew distant. Now Zhan is back, but only to threaten Lin away from one of 'his' investigations. What caused their relationship to grow so cold? Lin doesn't know, but he's determined to find out.

When some people transmigrate, they transmigrate into emperors or nobles, living lives of luxury and influence. Some people transmigrate into shizuns or sect leaders, revered by all and achieving extraordinary accomplishments. At the very least they transmigrate into villains, stirring up trouble with aspirations of "crushing the protagonist". Li Changtian, an upstanding young man of the modern age, died in the line of duty. In the blink of an eye. Hey! He transmigrated! He transmigrated into a criminal guilty of deeds so heinous that everyone wanted to beat him. Travelling official Yan Shu who hated injustice more than anything, stepped on him and said coldly: "A life for a life."

144054.description:
The second installment of the Sekai Series.

The music room in the second semester at Kazusaen Middle School, where the clock tower is not repaired. The relationship between Byouinzaka Meiro and Kushinaka Choushi began there. The school's three eccentrics, Kushinaka Kogushi, Douno Kurori, and Gakemura Rouya, maintain a distorted balance. And then a murder occurs. The search for the culprit begins, with Meiro and Choushi playing detective, and the collapsed balance is further shattered...

The fourth instalment of the Sekai Series.

For him, everything is a game.
Seven mysterious murders strike a prestigious girls' high school!

A mysterious and inexplicable murder takes place at the supposedly peaceful Senju Girls' School. What's more, the person who works there is the ethics teacher, Kushinaka Choushi. Fourteen years have passed since the incident involving Byouinzaka Meiro. The search for the culprit in this game of detective starts again. Who is the culprit?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 不気味で素朴な囲われたきみとぼくの壊れた世界
title.romaji: Bukimi de Soboku na Kakowashita Kimi to Boku no Kowareta Sekai

144057.description:
The fifth instalment of the Sekai Series.

An alleged prequel to "Kimi to Boku no Kowareta Sekai," when Byouinzaka Kuroneko and Hitsuuchi Samatoki were in middle school.

Note: Two of its chapters were released in Mephisto 2009 Vol. 2/3. Further chapters have yet to be released.
Nisio has mentioned Boku no Sekai in 2020 and 2021, saying how he has yet to finish Sekai Series and how he should, implying he may get around to finishing and releasing volume 5 soon.

144059.description:
The romantic comedy manga centers on a popular model who loves plastic models of warships, and her childhood friend who is in high school.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: プニプニとサラサラ あるいは模型部屋の少年と少女における表面張力と毛細管現象
title.romaji: Punipuni to Sarasara: Aruiwa Mokeibeya no Shounen to Shoujo ni Okeru Hyoumen Chouryoku to Mousaikan Genshou

synonyms: The skeleton girl is ambitious of evolution!

title.native: 最弱骨少女は進化したい!
title.romaji: Saijaku Hone Shoujo wa Shinka Shitai!

1, 6. Tennis-bu Buchou Ejiki (テニス部部長餌食); Comic Mujin 2010-02, kakioroshi
2. Tensai Shoujo Houkai (天才少女崩壊); Comic Mujin 2009-04

4. Shigekiteki Kairaku Densha (刺激的･快楽電車); Comic Mujin 2009-01
A girl moves into the countryside where public sex is evidently normal. She lies to her friend and claims that she's had sex and doesn't find it exciting. Then takes up a challenge to go on a train ride...

Baribari Hataraku Salaryman wa Naze Ganbareru no ka?

title.native: 背伸び少女といちゃラブ生活 加納千佳
title.romaji: Senobi Shoujo to Icha Love Seikatsu: Kanou Chika

144066.description:
Koharu is a shoujo manga editor on a mission to get the manga artist she's in charge of to write a big love story, and to that end, she begins a pseudo-romance with a pharmacist, Sawaki! She struggles to make any progress using her skills as a shoujo manga editor, but for the sake of gathering material, she has an "adult kiss" with Sawaki.

(Source: Tokyo Otaku Mode)

title.native: 少女マンガはお嫌いですか？
title.romaji: Shoujo Manga wa Okirai desu ka?

synonyms: A case where girls were kidnapped by monsters. Naked slimy island

title.native: 少女連続誘拐事件 ～裸のぬるぬるアイランド～
title.romaji: Shoujo Renzoku Yuukai Jiken: Hadaka no Nurunuru Island

144068.description: Kiryu has a rebellious attitude towards his stern-faced teacher Ibe. Their relationship seems to be terrible at first glance, but they are actually...!?? Kiryu was summoned to the teacher's office after being scolded in the classroom. The two silently put their lips together, as Kiryu opened his legs...

title.english: For the One Whom I Adore

144070.description:
The Qihuang Kingdom is run by women. As the head eunuch, Yan Lang’s dream was to wander aimlessly in life, and resign with honor while disguising herself as a man. However, Yan Lang unexpectedly encountered the biggest failure of her career when the new empress ascended to the throne. Wait a moment! Who could explain to her why the empress was a man? Yan Lang panicked and barely managed to beg him to spare her life. Before she could even celebrate, he forced a pill down her throat. “All this drug will do is to keep you in check. Behave well, and I will make sure you have nothing to worry about,” he said. “Just be a good empress! Starting today, I’ll be your loyal subject during the day, and serve you well at night,” she said. Every day, Yan Lang wandered on the edge of life. It wasn’t until one day that the empress discovered her secret that Yan Lang, the provincial commander, was a woman!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: The Self-Cultivation of the Provincial Commander

144071.description:
Orphaned by a monster attack on her village, young Alicia spends three horrid years in an orphanage before finally running away. When she flees, however, Alicia has a violent encounter with an older woman hell-bent on killing her. During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. Ready or not, she’s determined to carve her own path.

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: 身為女性向遊戲的女主角挑戰最強生存劇

title.english: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival
title.native: 乙女ゲームのヒロインで最強サバイバル
title.romaji: Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival

144072.description:
Our Female Lead was forced to replace her sister's place and become concubine to an elder Emperor. However, on her first night at the palace, the Emperor drops dead from poison, right at her feet! The Emperor's son witnesses this and strikes a deal with her, asking her to claim that his father's last wish was to pass the throne to him, and he will allow her the seat of Empress Dowager! Shocked and confused, our MC enters this deal with the new Emperor, and must find her own way to survive the Palace!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.english: The Widowed Empress Needs Her Romance

144073.description:
Like any proper noble lady, one must have certain acquired tastes. For Melphiera Marchalrayd, she just happens to crave a rather exotic protein—monsters! But do not judge! Despite its bad reputation, monster meat can be used in exquisite cuisine and Melphiera is determined to change the kingdom’s opinion of it! Unfortunately, since debuting in society, Melphiera has been struggling to find her perfect match…until she meets the fearless “Blood-Mad Duke” of Galbraith!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: アクジキレイジョウトキョウケツコウシャクソノマモノワタシガオイシクイタダキマス

title.native: 悪食令嬢と狂血公爵　～その魔物、私が美味しくいただきます！～
title.romaji: Akujiki Reijou to Kyouketsu Koushaku: Sono Mamono, Watashi ga Oishiku Itadakimasu!

title.native: お嫁さんにしたいコンテスト１位の後輩に弱みを握られた
title.romaji: Oyome-san ni Shitai Contest 1-i no Kouhai ni Yowami wo Nigirareta

144076.description:
He stole a pair of panties and was caught by his aunt, but to his surprise, she starts undressing in front of him instead of scolding him.

“You can touch me all you want… It is a special lesson just for you…”

(Source: TOPTOON+)
synonyms: プライベート×レッスン

144077.description:
Like any proper noble lady, one must have certain acquired tastes. For Melphiera Marchalrayd, she just happens to crave a rather exotic protein—monsters! But do not judge! Despite its bad reputation, monster meat can be used in exquisite cuisine and Melphiera is determined to change the kingdom’s opinion of it! Unfortunately, since debuting in society, Melphiera has been struggling to find her perfect match…until she meets the fearless “Blood-Mad Duke” of Galbraith!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: 悪食令嬢と狂血公爵　～その魔物、私が美味しくいただきます！～
title.romaji: Akujiki Reijou to Kyouketsu Koushaku: Sono Mamono, Watashi ga Oishiku Itadakimasu!

144078.description: This barber talks a lot even though he speaks so quietly...

144079.description:
The descendant of a once great wizarding family, Elric Mervinger is unable to perform magic due to a rare medical condition. While attempting to cure his disease, he stumbles upon the demon Mephistopheles, who tries to possess Elric to free himself from a dragon’s trap. But when Elric ends up absorbing Mephisto instead, the two become bound together. With Mephisto by his side, will this new power allow Elric to restore his family to its former glory? Or will he just end up being devoured?

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: 無口でエッチなお姉さんにペット扱いされる僕
title.romaji: Mukuchi de Ecchi na Onee-san ni Pet Atsukai Sareru Boku

144081.description:
A university professor is sick of seeing students doing it everywhere on campus. One day, a girl who seemed innocent approaches him with a special request...

"Can you... teach me about sex?"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

144082.description: A gag manga spin-off of AKB0048 set 10 years before the events of the anime. The story follows Ichinose Kaname and the wackiness that ensues around her at the AKB Zero Zero Girls Academy.

title.native: AKB0048外伝 とびだせ!AKBぜろぜろ女学園
title.romaji: AKB0048 Gaiden: Tobidase! AKB Zero Zero Jougakuen

144083.description:
The third instalment of the Saikyou Series.

Aikawa Jun, Humanity's Strongest Contractor. At the request of Nagatoro Toromi, she sets out for a newly-born volcanic island. What does Aikawa Jun have to compete for survival with? Plants?! A spectacle of the "strongest", sprouting from "nonsense", and growing beyond "human"!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Love Affair of Mankind's Strongest
Jun Aikawa's Failure Miss/ion3: Too Dead to Die
Jun Aikawa's Failure Miss/ion4: Battle of Wits with the Digital Detective
Jun Aikawa's Failure Miss/ion5: The Undefeated Gambler and the Failed Contractor

144084.description:
A fictionalized account of the life of the Shigeru Mizuki, alongside with Fukusawa, his (fictional) personal assistant of the last 40 years, based on Mizuki Pro's chief assistant. The story sees the pair working side by side, both at home and abroad in Europe and Bali. The manga also weaves in memories of Mizuki's personality from his coworkers.

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

144085.description:
The second instalment of the Saikyou Series.

Aiming for 10,000 metres depth in the deep sea!

Together with the genius psychologist Jikumoto Miyori, Aikawa Jun—a contractor—heads to the bottom of the sea in pursuit of a missing treasure ship and research team. As soon as they arrive, they are besieged by a school of man-eating fish!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Pure Love of Humanity's Strongest
The Passionate Love of Mankind's Strongest
Jun Aikawa's Failure Miss/ion2: The Altercation Association

144086.description:
The fourth instalment of the Saikyou Series.

Aikawa Jun, Humanity's Strongest Contractor. This time, she's been asked to protect the fortune teller's child, Himena Genki, from the "death" she predicted. What is the strongest way to change the future? An adventure story about falling in love with "nonsense", loving "humans", and being thrilled by "the strongest" comes to a close!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Love Song of Humanity's Strongest
The Love Fortune of Humanity's Strongest
The June Bride of Humanity's Strongest

144087.description:
The fifth instalment of the Saikyou Series.

The most strongest heroine in 10,000 years.

Aikawa Jun, a famous detective and Humanity's Strongest Contractor.
A non-stop mystery about two beautiful women and a serial killer.

Don't interfere with my journey. I'll kill you.

Aikawa Jun, Humanity's Strongest Contractor.
She is assigned to accompany Jikumoto Miyori, a nineteen-year-old authority on psychology, on a field investigation. It was supposed to be a fun trip with the addition of the overly perfect maid, Handa Rei. However, at their destination in Venice, a couple of tourists and famous actresses are brutally murdered one after another via drowning.
The "drowned killer" has his claws on these women, too—?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 人類最強のヴェネチア

synonyms: The Descendant of the Brave, Retired Incubus and Captive Life!?

title.native: 勇者の末裔、隠居インキュバスと監禁生活!?
title.romaji: Yuusha no Matsuei, Inkyo Incubus to Kankin Seikatsu!?

144089.description:
Moa’s in a pinch. Her friends are asking about her nonexistent sex life, but she’d rather die than admit that she’s a virgin. In a hurry, she makes up a haphazard lie: yeah, she’s had sex before. With a really hot imaginary guy called Yura! Not only is he ripped, well-hung, but he also…happens to be very, very real. When faced with the real Yura, there’s only one thought in Moa’s mind. She needs to make her lie become a truth!

(Source: Lezhin US)

144090.description:
The great hero Devota worked tirelessly to save the world from evil, only to be betrayed and killed by the very man who raised her. Luckily, she’s granted a new life as a young orphan named Diamond and, through a twist of fate, is taken in by an old comrade, now a powerful duchess. The whole family dotes on her like she’s one of their own, and as it turns out, she actually might be… But with her murderer still at large and her revenge still unfinished, will Dia be able to open her heart to love?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a 20-chapter side story
synonyms: 家族が私に執着します
My Family is Obsessed With Me
ครอบครัวนี้มีแต่คลั่งรัก

144091.description:
A secret that I, a maid of the imperial palace, accidentally heard… that the runaway fiancée of the prince was actually a man?!

"Please spare my life! I'll do anything!"
"Anything?"

As I desperately nodded my head, the prince gave a chilling smile. There's only one way to not get silenced permanently!

"Then I choose you."
"For what?"
"To be my fiancée."

To become the fiancée (replacement) of the prince.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.

144093.description:
Widowed on the day of her wedding, Yeo-Hun has lived a lonely life all alone... Until one day she learns the taste of love.

(Source: Lalatoon, translated)

144094.description:
In modern day Japan, humans with "divine power" are called "Himiko," and once receiving national certification, they are called "Kamisama" or "God." After Nagi's grandmother passes away, the shrine in her hometown no longer has a god and is in trouble. Nagi's twin brother, Takeru, inherited divine power but unfortunately is a hikikomori or shut-in.

By chance, Nagi enrols in "Kamisama Gakkou," the school where Himiko attend. Compelled to revive the shrine, Nagi aims to receive national qualification and become a god.
synonyms: Mein Untergang an der Schule Gottes

title.native: 神さま学校の落ちこぼれ
カメラ先輩と世話焼き上手な後輩ちゃん
title.romaji: Camera Senpai to Sewayaki Jouzu na Kouhai-chan

144096.description:
Contains:
1) Kanojo wa Sukidarake (She's Full of Love!)
2) Fukigen na Kanojo (A Moody Girl)
3) Onee-chan wa Shinpaishou
4) Tachibana-san no Kakushigoto (Tachibana-san's Secret)
5) Koi wa Amaku Sasayaku (Love Is a Sweet Whisper)
6) Senpai no Kawaii Tokoro (The Cute Parts About My Senpai)
7) Kimi o Suki ni Shitai (I Want To Do Whatever I Like To You)
8) Karada no Kyorikan
9) Kanojo wa Sukidarake Extra Chapter

144098.description:
A peaceful off day in a quiet residential area. Chino, an English teacher, has a bright and witty wife who is pregnant and nearing birth. But Chino's heart trembled when his student Yako visits him at home.

(Source: Adam, translated)

title.native: いたいのはこころです

144100.description:
The poor little top-scorer was bullied, so he transferred from a high-ranked high school to an ordinary one.

Class teacher: Zhan Ming, look at the score you got!
Zhan Ming: I'll ask my deskmate to teach me.
Former classmate: Gu Qinan, don't think we can't find you just because you transferred.
Gu Qinan: I'll get my deskmate to hit you.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

title.english: I’ll Get My Deskmate to Hit You
title.romaji: Wo Jiao Wo Tong Zhuo Da Ni

144101.description:
A syndicate led by female kingpin Gatling has taken the city by storm.

Qiao Anle was captured and subjected to inhumane tests that saw her inadvertently being given a superpower to control and manipulate vines. Swearing to avenge her slain family, she declared war on the wicked sisterhood of superpower beings that created her. But little did she realize that she could not secure her first victory without the help of an undependable scientist...

(Source: Webnovel, edited)

144102.description:
To save his empress, the emperor dives deep into the thousand year lake without thinking about his own safety. In the lake, he trickes a Xuan Long who was abandoned by his tribe to go to the palace, and coaxed the Xuan Long to give him his heart.

As a result of the frequent courting of the emperor, the Xuan Long sincerely fell in love with him. But in the end, he was put to death by the emperor, and disappeared like ashes after giving birth to a dragon.

At this moment, the emperor recovered the memories of his past life and realised that the person he killed was his lover, the one who he had been searching for for thousands of years.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Catch a Dragon, Become My Wife

144109.description:
Known for his angelic voice, Cheng Yi, a famous television anchor, was suddenly attacked by an overly obsessed fanboy confessing his love for him, causing him to fall off the stage and get sucked into a book where he ended up becoming a flower boy.

"Ah... But I'm straight! What?! And I have to do all sorts of stuff with this guy in front of me? What?! And every guy in the world will be craving for my body? Um... The beginning of this book has to be a joke! I think I might just loosen up a bit and let myself fly free!"

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 extras.

144110.description:
The violent and perverted emperor and the stubborn and cold minister! The beginning is very sad, but the end is very sweet!

Three years ago, a palace coup occurred, and Du Yuzhang abandoned his family just to save the life of his beloved. Unexpectedly, his beloved ascended the throne and no longer had any pity for him. From then on, during the day, he was the left prime minister Du Da who was powerful and above everyone else; at night, he became the plaything of Du Yuzhang, who was tossed around in the palace and under one person.

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: 陛下に愛されるのは難しい

144111.description:
Shen Zhuofeng, a beautiful General of the Divine clan, stumbles upon a mischievous Divine Beast Wolf. As he was trying to capture this wolf, he got bitten which made him to be his lifelong mate. With Shen not being able to get rid of his mark, will he be able to tame the handsome wolf?

(Source: INKR)

title.english: General, Watch Out For The Mad Dog!

title.native: 精霊使いエレメンタラー -些の塵滓-
title.romaji: Seirei Tsukai Elementalors: Chito no Jinshi

144113.description:
Others have an awesome reincarnation such as becoming a king or war general. But me? Why was I reincarnated as a treacherous prime minister that brings calamity to the people and betrays their country?! It’s terrifying you know, seeing how heads roll because of what the king said!

“Is there anything you’re dissatisfied with?” said the king with a pursed smile.
Trembling He Lanzi replied, “No your majesty, this prime minister wouldn't dare.”
“You’re acting distant like this, because you actually want me to...”
“No your majesty, please don’t !“

Blackhearted Younger Emperor X Beautiful Scholarly Tyrant Prime Minister.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

144114.description: Hakoda-san, who is in my class, always wears a box on her head. I wonder what's her true face...?

144115.description:
Since he started high school, Lu Jia has rarely called Mu Wenran “Big Bro”. Exceptions would be whenever he is lying or feeling nervous. Back when he didn’t want to do his homework, he would act sickly and say, “Big Bro, my head hurts” or “I understand everything in this chapter. I really do, Big Bro”. Yet now, 23-year-old Lu Jia will still cry in front of Mu Wenran.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

144117.description:
Collection published by Kadokawa of the chapters of the Twitter manga made by Kumaru Sanka. This volume contains chapters of "Kyojiri no Nirugame-chan to Usami-kun", "Doya Kawaunchiku Kanojo-chan", and "Tenshi na Tenkousei-chan to Kyonyuu Kyoufushou-kun".

Includes:
1. Prologue
2-17. Kyojiri JK Nirugame-chan
18-25. Doyakawa Kanojo, Tsutane-chan
26-31. Tenshi de Akuma na Terezuru-chan
32. Epilogue

144118.description:
Kiritaro, a young samurai born in the Warring States period, was searching for his mother. In the midst of his search, he met Kasumi, a young ninja of the Kouga school of ninjutsu. He spent a few happy days with Kasumi and her grandfather, Kasumi Hakuun, who was also a ninja master, before continuing on his journey. After Kiritaro left, Hakuun was killed by Shin Higashihara. Kasumi, now an orphan, was reunited with Kiritaro and set out together to find revenge for her grandfather.

This book is the author's memorable debut work, published by Tomoe Publishing in 1957. It is not only the starting point of his career as a manga artist, which began after working on picture books, but is also a notable work in manga history, as an origin of the Ninja Bugeicho and Kamuiden genres.

144119.description:
This is a virtual shop that sells desire. Whatever the customer wants, the black business card will be there like a promise, and the shop will deliver the appropriate item with magical effects. However, no one really knows what it costs to use these items. The urban legend of the “Strange Store” is swirling around the city. “The next business card…will it appear by your side?”

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

144120.description:
Yu Hwa-Rin is tragically betrayed by her close disciple and disappears from Murim. But after three years, she finally returns with a few new tricks up her sleeve. Now with the power of magic in her arsenal, she wields her martial arts to reclaim her honor!

(Source: BiliBili Comics, edited)

144122.description:
Notorious for her extravagant spending, Wilhazelle Fossier drove her house to complete financial ruin. To pay her family’s debt, she resolves to collect a bounty from the wealthy Duke Heillos by finding his missing nephew. Although her search is successful, until the skeptical duke can confirm the young boy’s identity, Wilhazelle must spend one month living at the Heillos manor. But when one month turns into one year and a contract marriage, she starts to wonder if the money is worth it!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Found a Husband When I Picked up the Male Lead
ฉันได้สามีหลังเก็บพระเอกไปคืน

144123.description:
Is the emperor in control or being controlled?

Wen Zhao, the prince of Qinghe, is the self-proclaimed number one playboy in the capital. After being forced to become Emperor he is brutally assassinated but miraculously comes back to life. Deciding to make an unexpected comeback, he uses all sorts of dirty tricks to make his entrance.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Rise of the Frivolous Emperor

144124.description:
After being reincarnated as the villainess of a novel, Yurina is determined to escape her fate of being killed by the story’s second male lead. Her solution? Save his life and get him on her side before he falls in love with the female lead! Her recollection of the story is spotty, but after months of searching, Yurina finally finds him-- or so she thinks. He’s a bit different from what she expected, but that’s probably because of her poor memory... Her plan should still work, right?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Raised an Obsessive Second Male Lead
เมื่อฉันเลี้ยงพระรองจอมหมกมุ่น

144125.description:
To pay off his debt, the diligent corporate slave Lin Xiang has no other way but to join a mysterious virtual game. As he levels up in the game system and expands his territory, the truth behind the game and the oligarchs' true aim gradually dawns on him. Can he finally uncover the ultimate conspiracy?

(Source: INKR, edited)

144126.description:
Life has been hard for Choi Hyunseong and his family since the portal gates appeared. That is, until he finally awakens! While he is unable to level up, he is gifted with the ability to trade goods on an interdimensional level and get items that raise his stats! Through the power of commerce, Hyunseong is gaining skills, storming dungeons, hunting monsters, and collecting loot to help his family. Level is nothing but a number, and he is seemingly unstoppable as… the level 1 player.

(Source: Tapas)

144127.description:
The second instalment of the Boukyaku Tantei Series.

A young man, Oyagiri Mamoru, works as a security guard at a museum.

Whenever he visits the area he guards, there's always a beautiful white-haired woman who stops in front of a particular painting. She is Okitegami Kyouko, also known as the Forgetful Detective. They were only supposed to be a guard and spectator until a number of tough cases involving art occurred—.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

144128.description:
The third instalment of the Boukyaku Tantei Series.

Kujirai, a man not aiming to commit a perfect crime. The beautiful woman he chooses as his "alibi testimony" is a white-haired detective who, worst of all, can only remember one whole day...... In the latest short story, "Okitegami Kyouko's Alibi Testimony," where the forgetful detective becomes a witness in a murder case. The newest story in the Forgetful Detective series brilliantly written by NISIOISIN!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: หนังสือท้าทายถึงยอดนักสืบเคียวโกะ

144129.description:
The fourth instalment of the Boukyaku Tantei Series.

Kakushidate Yakusuke is a young man with a history of false accusations. All kinds of misfortune befall him, and now a girl has fallen on top of him! A time-constrained mystery about a forgetful detective who loses her memory every time she sleeps!

A junior high school student attempts suicide by jumping off a building. A twenty-five-year-old young man named Kakushidate Yakusuke is present at the scene, but due to his innate tendency to be falsely accused by others, he is made a suspect. A suicide note, allegedly written by the girl, is left at the scene. Will Kyouko-san be able to clear the suspicions and solve the case?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

144130.description:
The fifth instalment of the Boukyaku Tantei Series.

With her resignation letter tucked into her breast pocket, Inspector Hatopa was shaken. Her last case is a drowned body found floating in a park fountain. However, due to its inexplicability, she is forced to investigate in cooperation with the famous forgetful detective, Okitegami Kyouko...... A detective wishing to quit and a workaholic detective. A strange tag team takes on the mystery!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Resignation Letter of Kyouko Okitegami

144131.description:
The sixth instalment of the Boukyaku Tantei Series.

The forgetful detective Okitegami Kyouko gives her "first" lecture. A dangerous love question is posed towards Kyouko-san while she's on stage leads to a false accusation, and a young man named Kakushidate Yakusuke receives an unexpected proposal...... Will the beautiful forgetful detective be able to stop the cursed marriage?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Marriage Registration of Kyouko Okitegami

144132.description:
The seventh instalment of the Boukyaku Tantei Series.

The famous detective known as Okitegami Kyouko loses her memories whenever she sleeps. She solves every case she takes on the same day, but today she receives a difficult case from a troubled detective. For some reason, she is called to an amusement park instead of a crime scene. The request is to clear a huge escape game faster than a suspect in a case......? She is beautiful, fashionable, and loves money. A time-constrained mystery with the forgetful detective, Kyouko-san!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Household Ledger of Kyouko Okitegami

144133.description:
The eighth instalment of the Boukyaku Tantei Series.

"I'll snatch the Eiffel Tower." --Miss Phantom Thief.
The forgetful detective, Okitegami Kyouko, is invited to Paris to stop a daring crime threat. However, the thief's true plan is to have Kyouko-san herself steal the Eiffel Tower......?! Stolen memories and a brilliant trap. Can her assistant, Kakushidate Yakusuke, save Kyouko-san from the thief's clutches?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Travel Journal of Kyouko Okitegami

144134.description:
The ninth instalment of the Boukyaku Tantei Series.

The forgetful detective, Okitegami Kyouko, is arrested as a suspect in a robbery-murder case. She was found asleep at the scene, clutching the bloody murder weapon, and had forgotten her memories of the incident. When Kyouko-san offers to investigate the case from inside her cage, she is confronted by Hitaisei, a strong police officer nicknamed "the False Accuser". As he struggles with his pride as a police officer, he chooses to ask for the help of the "forgetful detective expert", Kakushidate Yakusuke...?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Back Cover of Kyouko Okitegami

144135.description:
The tenth instalment of the Boukyaku Tantei Series.

The only employee of the Okitegami Detective Agency, Oyagiri Mamoru, receives a sudden threatening phone call. "If you want Okitegami Kyouko back, you'll have to come up with one billion yen." He is the only one who can rescue the lonely forgetful detective. Although he doesn't have the powers of deduction like Kyouko-san does, he does have a "memory" of her. Mamoru begins his investigation with his own hands. Meanwhile, Kyouko-san wakes up in the presence of the murderer—? The pure white Okitegami Detective Agency vs. the jet-black kidnapper! How will this head-to-head battle end?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Color Chart of Kyouko Okitegami

144136.description:
The eleventh instalment of the Boukyaku Tantei Series.

Okitegami Kyouko—her memory resets every time she sleeps. Taking advantage of this characteristic, she works as the "forgetful detective". In the name of business, she sets out on a trip with her bodyguard, Oyagiri Mamoru. She has no particular destination in mind. What kind of incident awaits them on this trip?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Train Ticket of Kyouko Okitegami

144137.description:
The twelfth instalment of the Boukyaku Tantei Series.

Someone calling themselves "9010" has posted a bomb threat on the internet. The time limit is nine hours. The ace of the bomb squad, Ryouinu Azana, manages both the explosives detection dog and the guide dog, proceeds with the investigation. Meanwhile, the forgetful detective Okitegami Kyouko joins in at the request of the suspect, Kakushidate Yakusuke.

Even with the swift deduction skills of the forgetful detective, will she solve it within the time limit?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

144138.description:

When Kyouko-san's powers of deduction are taken away, her partner, Yakusuke, is on the run!
How will she take on the series' greatest enemy? A time limit mystery!

"The characters on the ceiling. It was I who wrote them."

A young man, Yakusuke, has been deemed a suspect in an attempted murder case. As usual, he asks the forgetful detective, Okitegami Kyouko, to solve the case. However, in the middle of the case, Kyouko-san is shot. She survives but loses her great deduction ability. 144141.description:
Celebrating his 45th anniversary in 2019, Watase Seizo is a pioneer of color comics in Japan. His urban and stylish stories continues to attract many readers, especially with his masterpiece "Heart Cocktail" (1983-89).

Mr. Watase's works, which are comics full of charm in each single image, have a timeless universality that continues to be loved. They have been used in many fashion magazines, book covers, record/CD jackets, corporate advertisements, and calendars. In addition, there have been many promotional works drawn at the request of companies.

This book is a collection of rare short stories, including the title story "Heart Cocktail Renaissance" published in 2018, as well as works drawn for corporate tie-ins, all in one place. It will be a unique opportunity for long-time fans to be reunited with fantastic works, and for new readers to be touched by "Watase World" for the first time.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Heart Cocktail Renaissance (ハートカクテル ルネサンス, 2017)

Six years ago, when Wu-Ju lost her father, she came across a kind-hearted alien in the mountains. Ever since then, she’s been an avid fan of aliens, but she pretends not to believe in their existence out of fear that her classmates will ostracize her. Agnes, a noblewoman was ridiculed in the social circles for being unfashionable, happened to help Nazelbert, the duke's son, who had been betrothed to the Princess.

With his escape in reach, it seems like everything will be over soon—until someone catches him. Yeo Tae-Ju, a sadistic alpha who seems to take pleasure in other’s pain, gives Eui-Hyun the choice to pay off his debt with his body but when the omega refuses, Tae-Ju proves he has no other choice.

Still desperate for escape, Eui-Hyun tries to plan his next attempt while doing restaurant work. But with a sorry paycheck that barely covers his interests and his little brother to care for, will Eui-Hyun have to sell his body after all just to survive? And, is it even worth surviving if this is what his life is meant to be?

She is so technologically inept that Kanata goes over to her house to help set it up for her. However.......

His parents were uncomfortable with his coloring, which no human is supposed to be born with, until one day he was banished from the family home. At a loss, Alec happens to meet two girls who seemed like adventurers. At their suggestion, Alec changes the color of his hair and eyes, and enrolls in the Academy of Heroes without telling anyone about his true identity. Alec's life at the academy is a lively one, but there is a secret legend about the color of his hair and eyes that even he doesn't know...

(Source: Alphapolis, translated)

Setting off on his own with nowhere to go, Alec happens across two girls, Relina and Teal, who seem like adventurers. The encounter opens up a whole new world for him to explore!

144297.description:
A one week romance with a guy you’ve never ever thought of before!

Chan-U's friend, who had implied that Chan-U was incapable of holding hands with a man, bets that he wouldn’t be able to date a man for a week. Angry at his provocation, Chan-U accepts the bet in the spur of the moment.

Chan-U's friend then points to Eun-Ho and asks him to date him for a week. However, Chan-U, who has a guilty conscience, decides to disclose the bet to Eun-Ho.
“I would like to be part of that bet too.”
"W-what?"
Should we… date for a week?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

The rules are simple: the motorcycles must be pre-1940 models, and all shots are allowed as long as the weapons used are pre-1860. Serazard set off on an English BSA G35-14 motorcycle with a sidecar.

Serazard soon meets two companions: Sherlock Maybach and Gen Daiba. They decide to make common cause to win the race and put an end to Tsender's regime. But something is wrong with the two men. They claim to have participated in the great battle that claimed the lives of Serazard's parents, but there were no survivors... And why do they seem to appear only at night? Could they be ghosts?

Luciana realized she had been reincarnated as a villainess in an otome game. But in her previous life, she was lonely single woman, so she had fantasized about a life where she would be popular with all the men if she were reincarnated.

I made up my mind! In order to avoid condemnation, I'm going to avoid all the potential romantic targets, and I'm going to live this life quietly!

From a mundane existence to an extraordinary adventure! Luciana, once an ordinary woman, now finds herself reincarnated as the stunning villainess of an otome game. Well aware of impending plot twists, she's ready to rewrite her destiny and avoid catastrophe. She hatches a brilliant plan to live a peaceful life and avoid troublesome suitors. Surprise! These persistent men refuse to take a hint! And if that weren't enough, she also possesses incredible, unparalleled magical abilities. What about this world has made her so special?

After my family fell on hard times, I, Hergenes Targael, disguised myself as a male mercenary named Herge to make money. Along the way, I rescued and met Shaun Kyroxus, a formidable ally who I abruptly left when I was needed back home. Sometime later, I am now part of an arranged marriage with none other than... Shaun?! He’s dying to see Herge again, and it’s only a matter of time before he finds out! I'm not sure if this marriage will work out, and what do I do when he finds out?!

144319.description:

When Liliha, a princess from the surface, makes her way to the Canopy, they both realize that there is more to their world than they knew. Kaina agrees to help Liliha return to the Great Snow Sea far below, where her kingdom is imperiled by the rapacious neighboring kingdom of Bargia.

The trip is arduous, and foes lie in wait at the end of their descent. With Liliha taken prisoner and her father the king too caught up in politics to rescue her, Kaina has no choice but to set off with only the young prince in tow, braving the dangers of the Great Snow Sea to rescue Liliha from Bargia's clutches...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

No one ever really notices her, as if she was a ghost, but Grand Duke Dietrich can't seem to take his eyes off her. Seeing his rival's interest in the girl, Prince Elias resolves to use her for his own advantage in the battle for the throne. As misunderstandings and mystery surrounding Maria grow, she's quickly going from invisible to intriguing to... potentially irresistible!

A high profile gag love story between Yong-Heon, who wants the world his way, and the purest, most innocent Prince in the world!

Yong-Heon, the third son in a family of famous chefs, emerges as a next generation patisserie with his excellent skills and star power, but is in a crisis because of a scheme cooked up by his brother and rival. To make things worse, Yong-Heon is betrayed by his lover, causing him to lose his sense of taste from the extreme stress and trauma, and he is unable to continue cooking. He desperately tries to hide the truth, but remains in crisis because of persistent paparazzi.

After having his self confidence and cooking torn away from him, Yong-Heon has lost his reason for living and now lives the fast life in despair. But on his 26th birthday, locked up in his vacation villa, he wakes up to find Keith, who appears as if sent as a present.

Ju-Hyeok is a clueless beta who is thrust into the messy world of alpha-omega dynamics when he leaves his wholesome beta college to work at a more diverse company. Repulsed by the pheromones that trump common sense in this crazy environment, Ju-Hyeok swears himself off dating until he saves up enough money to move to a faraway haven for betas. Unfortunately, fate seems to be working against him when he somehow attracts both the flirtatious alpha director and the cute omega junior at his company without lifting a finger. Ore Dayo! Wario Dayo!! (オレだよ！ワリオだよ！！) is a Japanese-published Wario comic book series written by Yukio Sawada, published by Shogakukan, and serialized in the Japanese magazine CoroCoro Ichiban! The series is based on more recent Wario games, including Wario World, Wario: Master of Disguise, and Wario Land: Shake It! The comic series has had references in Super Mario-Kun, a comic by the same author, including Wario's punch-line, "Ore Dayo! Wario Dayo!!" (It's me! Wario!!)

Country life is supposed to be idyllic, isn’t it? A peaceful place full of amiable neighbors with big hearts, right? That’s what Ji-Woo is looking forward to… But out of all the next-door neighbors to have, he gets Dong-Chan. Curt, stand-offish, and inscrutable, Dong-Chan isn’t the most welcoming of folks. In fact, he looks like he doesn’t want Ji-Woo and his family here at all. Bemused but not daunted, Ji-Woo tries his best to adjust to life in the country…until it turns out that someone is trying to chase his family away from here. Jiwoo has his suspicions, but will he be able to find the real culprit?

144342.description:
A side story manga to the long-running "Super Mario-kun" series, following the events of the 2014 3DS video game "Yoshi's New Island".

Story goes as follows: "the couple to whom the stork delivered Baby Mario and Baby Luigi allege that the brothers are not their babies. The stork then flies away to search for the real parents, when he clashes with Kamek and his goons once more. Kamek proceeds to defeat the stork in a fight and kidnap Baby Luigi, but Baby Mario slips and falls on the nearby Egg Island. He is found by a group of Yoshis who decide to take him to his brother and defeat Baby Bowser, now that he is planning to turn Egg Island into his resort.

After Baby Bowser is defeated at his castle, it is up to the iconic duo to head over to the stork and Baby Luigi to rescue them."

The only person who came to greet him was his younger brother, Xie Zhun, who had personally sent Xie Ci to prison five years ago. Expensive shoes, a nice watch. Smoldering good-looks. That’s the new guy, Doh Jaeha, appointed to lead a new team in the company. Tae-eun is a third-year copywriter who’s vying to join this new group to move his career forward. Jaeha seems a bit strict but if he’s achieved this position already at his age, he must be competent, right? But something suddenly dawns on Tae-eun… This Jaeha...is this the same Jaeha he went to school with, his first crush?! Second chances at love don’t come around very often. But they were just kids when they first met, surely things are different now. Still, this guy is confident, hot and seems interested, why not make the most of this opportunity? But office romances are always complicated and there’s a new air about Jaeha that feels just a little off… Love and lust ensue but things aren't quite as they seem...

144361.description:
Born in the small mountain village of Domremy in France, she rose to eventually carry a flag in the front lines of a feudal war, and still stands today as the tragic symbol of freedom in France: Jeanne d'Arc. Country, family, village, descent... and the opposite sex... A human story where many types of love intertwine. The five burning years of the girl named Jeanne, who later came to be known as La Pucelle d'Orleans (The Maid of Orleans), passed in the blink of an eye. Kurashina Ryou, famous for his "Empress" series, joins up with the sentimental Shiba Akio for a new interpretation, boasting gentle and elegant scenes, as well as a tragic darkness that swallows up time into a swirl of conspiracy... 144373.description:
Roost, an alchemist who specialized in basic research, found out that the guild's bureaucrats didn't understand his work and cut his budget to zero (!) for the next fiscal year.
Realizing that there was no future for him at the Alchemist Guild, he decided to resign.
However, Roost was in fact the world's top alchemist, and the materials he produced were at an extremely high level that no one else can recreate.
After Roost's resignation, the guild fell into turmoil, but it was too late.

Freed from the confines of his former workplace, Roost will begin a slow life on the frontier, developing new alchemy at his leisure!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

144374.description:
The love between brother and sister. The love between man and woman. That which is most forbidden is most unyielding. The two sons and five daughters of the Shiunji family shine like brilliant gems, each with intelligence and beauty in equal measure. And with the pedigree of their wealthy father behind them, how could they not be the talk of the town? Eldest son Arata has spent his life being tossed around by the whims of his colorful sisters, yet a little teasing won’t stop him from valuing his family over anything and anyone else. But when his youngest sister turns fifteen, their father reveals a long-hidden secret of the Shiunji “siblings” and knocks Arata’s world off its axis…

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: The manga is getting their chapters published first on Miyajima's Fanbox account, and then some days later on the Young Animal magazine from Hakusensha editorial.

144375.description:
Rohan Kishibe has been devitalized by the COVID-19 pandemic and stressed by his editor's criticism, as well as an obsessive stalker outside his house. On a walk with his dog Bakin, the manga artist stumbles by chance upon an evil spirit that steals entire seasons of his life. As Rohan attempts to outwit the spirit, he must also deal with his stalker, whose relationship with his possessed self threatens both his editor's life and his own future.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

144376.description:
One day, Roost, an alchemist, was suddenly told by the Alchemy Guild, his workplace, that the research budget of his Basic Research Division will be cut to zero. Roost, who had been treated as a lowly servant, decided to resign. Because a female knight, a friend from his school days who became the lord of a remote area, invited him to help cultivate her territory.

"I don't think there's much that an ordinary alchemist like me can do?"

But in fact, Roost was one of the best alchemists in the world, and the materials he made are too advanced for others to recreate. When Roost left, the Alchemy Guild was thrown into chaos, but it was too late. Roost arrived in the frontier region, and the people there appreciated him much more, as Roost, a modest but extraordinary alchemist, will help to tame the frontier through the power of alchemy!

(Source: MF Bunko, translated)

144378.description:
The VR game "Tactics Chronicle" is a kingdom-building game. One day, Helian, a top player as the king of a land of demons, was suddenly transported into the game world itself. And there he found the game characters ruling the kingdom in his name...! This is the epic story of a weak human king who will lead a mighty army of warriors and demon-beasts to conquer a fantasy world!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

Notes:
- Cancelled due to mangaka's health.
- Chapters 1 to 12 were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases. Chapter 13 was not compiled in a volume.

144379.description:
Helian, the top player at the kingdom-management VR game called "Tactics Chronicles," was transported into the game world itself.
There he encountered a large army of demons running loose. And then there were the former NPCs, who have become the one-hundred-strong warlords. Helian hid his identity and set out on a quest with his vassals, only to find a tribe of elves who were being tormented by a giant malice. Seeing the tears of innocent people touched his heart, and he awakened to his true calling as a king. With righteous anger, he made up his mind.
With 100,000 demon troops under his banner, he will bring down the hammer with all his might on these atrocities!

"Rise up, my proud people!　Now is the time to respond with a roar!"

The thunderous roar that will shake the world, as his demon warriors march forward in unison with the mighty demon beasts known as archimera!

(Source: GA Bunko, translated)
synonyms: Isekai Kokka Archimera: Saijaku no Ou to Musou no Gunzei

144380.description:
Due to his master's scheme, Yi Gwol, Head Disciple of the Skysword Sect, was sent off to war. After 70 grueling years of military service, he's finally permitted to retire from his position as Grand Commander. Once he regains his youth through rejuvenescence, Yi Gwol secretly passes on several powerful swords to his junior disciples before starting his carefree life as a teahouse owner. But what began as a small gesture is about to cause a big conflict in the martial world...

(Source: Tapas)

144381.description:
It’s only sleeping together while holding hands, nothing else. That’s what Shin Wooseo tells himself when a red ring that ties a person to their soulmate appears on his finger one day. Once two people get tied by the ring, they cannot fall asleep unless they’re physically together. However, his destined partner isn’t his long-term friend and secret crush, Kang Jiseok, but rather his older brother, Kang Jigeon! And so starts the tragedy of loving one brother but having to share beds with the other. Although, it might not entirely be a tragedy, as Kang Jigeon doesn’t seem so disappointed about being tied to his younger brother’s best friend…

(Source: Tappytoon)

144382.description:
Business student Ma Dongjae is cursed with only ever falling for ultra-straight dudes, so you can just imagine the luck he’s had with love. All he really wants is a relationship of his own, but his own poor taste keeps getting in the way! Finally, Dongjae is propositioned, but…it’s by a weirdo in the campus changing rooms. It doesn’t matter how sexy he is, Dongjae has to turn him down, obviously! That should be the end of it, but fate just loves messing with Dongjae, and so they end up not only sharing a class but also being assigned to work on the same project! The thing is, the cool and aloof man who introduces himself is nothing like the creep Dongjae met before. One minute he’s hot, the next minute he’s cold, and half the time he seems to forget they’ve ever even spoken. It’s almost like he’s two different people…

(Source: Lezhin)
synonyms: รักครั้งนี้ จะพังอีกไหมนะ?

144383.description:
“I want a boyfriend too!”

When Mai, who has no experience talking to boys and even less with love, meets Kei Kurose when she starts high school, the wrong sort of sparks fly. Kei might be super good-looking—but he treats girls like trash. Mai has no patience for his rude attitude, but when she coincidentally discovers his secret part-time job, she might just have to learn to keep his trust?!

(Source: Yen Press)

144384.description: The kitsune is bound by a curse to her captor, but it's much too strong to be broken…

title.romaji: Hiretsu na Noroi Nanka ni wa Kusshinai Youko-chan

144385.description: Roland is known throughout the world as the Black Knight. He appears calm, cool, and collected on the outside, but secretly he’s anything but - he can’t talk to girls for the life of him. One day, while doing his regular heroic thing, he comes across a slave girl bound and gagged. Roland suddenly realizes - if he saves this slave girl, he can slowly build up his social skills by talking to her. After all, a slave girl has to be as shy as him, right? Okay, now read the title again.
synonyms: My Slave is Way Too Cheerful

title.native: 怜央先輩は無気力甘い。

144387.description:
Sako Machika is perfect and without flaws. She’s at the top of the student year with her excellent grades and has a cute face that makes everybody look twice. Excelling at her club, skilled at housework and chores, she’s the target of every boy’s admiration.

“I…like you.”

Wait, Sako-san confessed to me?! But…I’m just a nobody, we’re not a good match for each other! Yet out of nowhere—

“It’s such a botched haircut, right?”

“You were looking at my thighs the entire time.”

She would suddenly cut her long and beautiful hair, shortening her skirt, showing an imperfect appearance while relentlessly approaching me…

“As long as I’m not perfect—I have a chance, right?”

It’s all an attempt to make us seem like a better match?!

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.
synonyms: The Perfect Sako-san Wants to Become Like A Mob Character (Me)

144388.description:
"The White Devil", that was the alias of the strongest boy in the city.
Even after crushing a hundred enemies in the delinquent playground of Tohoku, there was not a single drop of blood on his shirt.
His legendary feats made his name known all over the country, and it was whispered that all the delinquents in the land will bow down to him......

One day, he disappeared.

Time flies, and the delinquent gangs are in full swing. In Nekoka Ward, Tokyo's roughest section, a huge fight was about to begin with six high schools participating to crown the second "White Devil." In the midst of this madness, an otaku boy arrived in Nekoka-ku.

His name is Amuro Range.

He is the original "White Devil," a retired delinquent who once reigned supreme over Tohoku with overwhelming power.

(Source: MF Bunko, translated)

144389.description:
A world where one's life is decided by one's talent, called a "Gift." The main character, Erio Scarlet, who was born in the house of an influential noble family that had produced a lot of Holy Knights, manifested a suspicious Gift called "Incubus" in the conferment ceremony. Furthermore, the only skill attached to that Gift was one embarrassingly called "Peerless."

Erio was banished from the city because there was no way his indecent existence could be permitted in a family of Holy Knights, but... somehow he went through an amazing growth when he dealt with his horniness?! In addition, when his childhood friend who was bestowed with the Gift "Sacred Knight" chased after him and reverse ra... did it with him, a lot of powerful indecent skills showed up, and on top of that they even got bound by Master-Servant contract...?!

This is the indecent heroic tale of the boy who was gifted with and indecent Gift rising in the world while "getting along" with a lot of girls.

As result, she has conceived a child, Ashley, who was later told that she shared the same eye and hair color as the man who had kidnapped her mother. She wears glasses and an Alice band that use the power of magic to make her look disagreeable in others' eyes, and thus gets called an "ugly four-eyes." Unable to make any friends, Ashley used to lead an academy life of loneliness and solitude…

However, after her encounter with a mysterious creature, the crown prince grows interested in her…?

144443.description:
Crooked businessmen and civil servants got you down? Call the undertaker of the tax world, the Tax Reaper. Jae-Hyeon Sin has a gift that lets him see the amount of illegally withheld taxes as a number floating above people’s heads. But when he uses this ability to whistleblow on someone in his own company, he gets the axe. Branded a traitor in the business world, he decides to become a government employee and catch all the dirty white-collar criminals that profit through tax loopholes. Who’s neck will the Tax Reaper’s righteous blade strike next?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

144444.description:
"Will you always be with me, next to me?"
"Yes. Always."
We made a promise when we were children. Since then, Tsumugi and I have always done everything together, and our relationship was supposed to be unchanging. But then...

"I want to fall in love. Can you write a story about it?"

Tsumugi, who was weak and in the hospital, asked me to write a novel about a romance between her and a boy I used to know.
Our relationship began to change from that single "request". What was Tsumugi really looking for in love and fiction?
A coming-of-age story spun between me, her, and him.

(Source: Gagaga Bunko, translated)
synonyms: I wish I had never written this novel.

title.native: こんな小説、書かなければよかった。

144445.description:
“You may be rich, but that doesn’t mean you can just do whatever you want with others!” A young man with nothing to lose will do anything to rise to the top.

144448.description:
My one-night stand from Paris is my new boss?! Ji-An, an editor of the fashion magazine The Runway, impulsively leaves to Paris after finding out about her ex-fiance’s affair. She meets a mysterious, handsome, and somewhat cynical guy who helped her from pickpockets in Paris, and ends up having a one-night stand with him. 3 months later, she meets him again-at her office, as an elite new chief editor from France!

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

144453.description: Momoi Kampachi, as a child, loved the manga Ashita no Joe and followed his dream to become a professional boxer, but at the age of 24, he was diagnosed with a career ending injury. As hard as it was to turn away from the one thing that he worked his entire life for by sacrificing everything else, it was inevitable. His longtime friend, Oume Hiromichi, who works as an editor at a manga publisher, gets him a job. Kampachi has to restart his life and needs to learn everything from scratch but he brings the same passion he had for boxing to being an editor and fights his way through the corporate world, round by round.

Rakugo--the ultimate form of storytelling, where everything in a story is expressed with just your body and words. Shinta and his daughter Akane have been seduced by this wonderful form of classical entertainment. Having observed her father strive to pass the shin'uchi rakugo test, Akane will take her own steps into this unique world!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Notes:
- Ranked 3rd in the 8th Next Manga Awards print manga category in 2022.
- Ranked 4th in the Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2023 guidebook for male readers.
- Ranked 3rd in the Nationwide Bookstore Employees' Recommended Comics of 2023.
- Ranked 2nd in the 16th Manga Taisho in 2023.
- Nominated for the 47th Kodansha Manga Award in the shounen category in 2023.
- Included in the New York Public Library's 2023 Best Books for Teens.
- Included in YALSA's 2024 Great Graphic Novels for Teens.

144868.description: The fall of his first year in middle school, Arata Kouda meets a strange bird-like creature named Kujima. Seeing he’s hungry, Arata invites him into his home to eat. There he encounters Arata’s older brother, a shut-in studying for his next entrance exam. After a tense meeting Kujima decides to start freeloading at their house during the winter until the warm spring comes.

title.native: クジマ歌えば家ほろろ
未確認生物ラバネロちゃん
アンノウンサマーソング

144871.description:
Transmigrating into a novel as a minor side character, Shen Jintai was determined to remake himself by completing the missions from the system "Xiao Ai." He has to become prettier in order to become a star in the entertainment industry. And he has to get between the male lead Yan Qiuchi and his partner Bai Qingquan so that Yan Qiuchi will focus more on his career. Yan Qiuchi originally disliked Shen Jintai aggressively, but now his attitude towards Yan Qiuchi has been getting more and more ambiguous?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Love Rival Is Getting Prettier Everyday
