title.native: 海外マスターとここだけの話
title.romaji: Kaigai Master to Koko Dake no Hanashi

144875.description:
Xuan Min was a monk who had lost his memories but still possessed some knowledge about Feng Shui and Geomancy. On his first day in Ningyang, he unceremoniously ransacked a haunted house. He exorcised the place and incidentally took Xue Xian, the true dragon nesting in it, with him.

From then on, the story of a partially paralyzed dragon and an aloof monk began as they joined hands and traveled to look for dragon bones and memories together.

(Source: Bilibili)

144876.description:
Xing Tian has suffered many setbacks his entire life. He fell from being a Divine god to a god of war, and then again from being a god of war to a demon king. There has only been one person he longs for and chases after, but that person has forgotten about him again and again. Xing Tian consoles himself: it’s alright, he is a fish after all. And fishes…don’t have good memory…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: This manhua and its characters are based on ancient Chinese mythology recorded in Shanhaijing, or the Classic of Mountains and Seas.

144877.description:
Lilith, a 500-year-old vampire, is determined to leave her harem of pretty boys behind! She is going to take on the human world by herself? Will she be an overpowered dominating queen? Or will her innocence get her into trouble?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.native: 未来はこれから描くところ
title.romaji: Mirai wa Kore kara Kaku Tokoro

title.native: 恋見る友田に恋する愛花
title.romaji: Koi Miru Tomoda ni Koisuru Aika

144882.description:
The son of the supreme being, Qin Shu, is a Son of God, but he was born with a mortal body and mortal fragility. Being despised by everyone in the Heavenly Path, his identity is even about to be taken away and himself demoted to the mortal world, until he activates the Myriad Realm Registration System!

(Source: Webcomics)
synonyms: クエストクリアで万界を制覇する

title.english: Reborn to be a Supreme Emperor

144883.description:
It is a dark age where demons are rampant. While a savior is eagerly awaited, a kind-hearted princess is chosen by the holy sword...? The strongest knight and the tomboy princess. A heroic tale with a new sensation!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

144885.description: A comedy about a 60-year-old man and a 560-year-old elf who are married with a difference in age of 500 years!

title.native: すごい年の差夫婦の話

144886.description:
Since graduating from nursing school, she's been living a boring life going back-and-forth between home and work. Her only entertainment was a harem otome game, until the game's narrator transmigrated her into the game world itself. Now she's plunged right into the middle of the palace intrigue, but thanks to her nursing skills she earned a place in the palace. She even got to seduce the handsome captain of the palace guard! This is much more exciting than the ordinary life she was living before...!

(Source: Renai Max, translated)

title.native: 転生！？武官とにゃんにゃん～後宮艶事録～
title.romaji: Tensei!? Bukan to Nyan Nyan: Koukyuu Enjiroku

144887.description:
A love affair with a brown-skinned prince that breaks all rules! Mai is a stern-faced woman who can't seem to hold down a regular job because she lacked communication skills despite her practical skills. A few weeks ago, she was fired from her part-time job for misreading a situation. Trying to become more social, she signed up for a dating app to relax and to improve her communication skills. She found an unexpected match. The other party is an oil tycoon...?

(Source: MIU Renai Max, translated)

title.native: 石油王からいいね！が届きました
title.romaji: Sekiyuou kara ii ne! Ga Todokimashita

144888.description:
1-3. Kazoku Soukan Game (家族相姦ゲーム); Comic Mugen Tensei 2017-11, 2018-01, 03
4-6. Mama Tomo Harem (ママ友ハーレム); Comic Mugen Tensei 2017-05, 07, 09

144889.description:
Awakening again in the void, the first person I saw was you. I secretly resolved that this time I would crush that comical and pathetic plan, and this time I would save you... But who was I talking to?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

144892.description:
To Yang Juan, He Lang seems to be just an Internet Cafe Manager who lives frugally and saves up money to buy dresses. In the world of an online game, Yang Juan portrays a naive, adorable, and soft girl - at least that's what He Lang thinks. The honest Yang Juan was entrusted by his roommate to control a female character's gaming account and use it to expose a cheating, in-game partner. By day, he's a serious and studious scholar. But at night, Juan Yuan goes online to play a gentle girl. And every day, he tries his absolute best not to expose himself.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 13 extras.

144893.description:
In the third year of the Sui Dynasty, the emperor Yan Jian established Jiejianfu, a spy agency to support his conquests. On a snowy night, the tribute caravan from the Yutian kingdom was robbed and slaughtered. On order of the Emperor, Feng Xiao, the second-in-command at Jiejianfu, was sent to investigate. In Liugong Town, he ran into Cui Buqu, an agent from Zuoyueju, there on a mission of his own. The two prideful agents didn't get along at first, but as they fought each other in a battle of wits, they began to realize that their missions had a common enemy lurking in the shadows. When they finally decided to cooperate, an enormous organization called Yunhai Shisanlou began to emerge…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

synonyms: The dick always wins in the end!

title.native: 必ず最後にちんこ勝つ

144895.description:
When Liang Si Che was 17, he was chosen by the famous film director Cao Xiu Yuan to live with his son Cao Ye, in order to gain life experience and prepare him for a role in Cao's film. After 3 months of living together, the two teenagers became close, but only one person could star as the male lead. They both secretly planned give the opportunity to the other, but in the end, Cao Ye gave up the audition so Liang Si Che could fulfill his dream of becoming a famous actor. Soon after, Cao Ye fought with his father, but Liang Si Che did not support him, and due to a misunderstanding, Cao Ye decides to go abroad.

Ten years later, the two cross paths once again on a film set. Can the misunderstanding be resolved...?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

144896.description:
As an e-pal, it took Chi Yu an entire year to snag the top spot on the e-pal platform. Then, he met the most difficult rival of his career, who struck him down from his throne. However, he never expected that his rival would be...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Contains:
1. Yamitsuki
2. Oazuke!!
3. Fan Event
4. Loli Bitch☆Gekokujou
5. Uwasa no Mao-chan
6. Yume no Naka
7. Mizugi♥Skinship

144903.description: In a planet with an ocean of sand, humans live in robot-like houses. They survive by defeating monsters and harvesting their oil which is needed for operating their houses. One day our hero meet a group of people who are building a rocket and aiming to leave Earth.

144904.description:
Located in the north, south, east, and west, just like flower petals. Those four kingdoms that border each other are known as “The Four Blossoms”. In each of these four kingdoms, there are saints who are called as “Butterflies of the Four Blossoms”. The Butterfly of the West, Carnelia is about to visit the Southern Kingdom for the first time as her duty.

What awaits her there, is.....

title.native: 恋唄う蝶は四つ花に舞う
title.romaji: Koi Utau Chou wa Yottsu Hana ni Mau

144905.description:
This time, our dark-skinned gal is "Angie," a nurse intern.
While treating a student with a leg injury, she conducts a medical examination for practice. As she listened to his heartbeat, he gets sexually aroused by the close contact of Angie's big tits. Angie strips off her lab coat and presses her big brown tits into the face of the student, as she begins her hands-on "sex education" with the virgin student...!

(Source: Fanza, translated)
synonyms: Practical Lessons with a Black Gal Nurse

144908.description:
Silvia has been reincarnated into the world of an adult otome game as the daughter of a marquess. As a devoted fan of the game, she's overjoyed and eager to experience the game to the fullest. She's ready to enjoy every single erotic scene with her own body! As Silvia sets eyes on a man to romance, the irresistible prince rains on her parade with his overwhelming affection, throwing things off course! Nothing goes the way Silvia plans as the plot continues to go off the rails!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: I'm Troubled by the Prince's Love
I'm Troubled by the Prince's Love ~Reincarnated Heroine, the Otome Game Struggle~

title.english: I'm Troubled by the Prince's Overwhelming Affection: A Reincarnated Heroine's Struggles in an Otome Game
title.native: 王子様に溺愛されて困ってます ～転生ヒロイン、乙女ゲーム奮闘記～
title.romaji: Ouji-sama ni Dekiai Sarete Komattemasu: Tensei Heroine, Otome Game Funtouki

title.native: 花きゃべつひよこまめ

144911.description:
Yuka is a streamer who enjoys putting on a sexy show for random men online, but is always careful to hide her real identity. One day she receives a letter from someone claiming to know her secret. What will the sender want with her in exchange for his silence...?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Notes:
- Originally published as a doujinshi series.
- Includes two extra chapters.
- Released at Sunshine Creation 2021 Autumn, Comic Market 99, 100, 102, 103, 104, 107.

title.native: 野々原柚花のヒミツのハイシン
title.romaji: Nonohara Yuka no Himitsu no Haishin

144912.description:
Real maids are gonna serve you. ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2017-03

144913.description:
Exhausted with his workload at the office, Shu shops around for partners on a dating app, looking for a strictly physical relationship-no idle chit-chat, and no strings attached. Meanwhile, Yukiya is a high school student who can't understand his discomfort when considering dating girls and decides to see how things go with men.

They'd expected it to be a one-night stand. Still, they're surprised by their compatibility and end up being friends with benefits. It was supposed to be strictly physical, but the more they see each other, the deeper their feelings for each other become! Then, one day, they run into each other in town!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra chapter.

144914.description:
The strongest young man with room to spare vs. the ex-baritone, bad-tempered boss. The worst, the grumpiest, the ... sweetest relationship.

"You're still so cool when you're handcuffed, aren't you? That's what I like about you."

Masatsugu Amatsugi, a 20-year veteran, is humiliated by the fact that he's being held in the hands of his hired cleaner. The young, brawny, cocky, muscularly built Ichiro Harima has plenty of room to spare. The passive pleasure of being seduced and pushed around by him has become so familiar to his body that it feels as if he is in love with him, but he will never admit it.

synonyms: アゲ×バン~バンド少女キャバクラDiary~
Age x Ban: Bando Shoujo Cabaret Kyabakura Diary

144917.description: Elcan, a dark magician, is fired from his party due to his lack of talent with offensive magic. As he wandered the streets he came across twins, who were abandoned by their parents. "I couldn't be a good dark magician, but I want to make their lives better!" He decided to retire from being an adventurer and raise these two girls as his own. And so, he raised his daughters, Corona and Selena. Teaching them black magic and enrolling them in a prestigious magician's academy. After learning more about magic, the girls return to see their father with some important news... They are S-rank Sages?! And they want to form a party with him?! A new adventure between a father and his daughters begin!

title.native: 僕のかわいい娘は双子の賢者 ～特技がデバフの底辺黒魔導士、育てた双子の娘がＳランクの大賢者になってしまう～
title.romaji: Boku no Kawaii Musume wa Futago no Kenja: Tokugi ga Debuff no Teihen Kuro Madoushi, Sodateta Futago no Musume ga S-Rank no Daikenja ni Natte Shimau

144918.description: Elcan, a dark magician, is fired from his party due to his lack of talent with offensive magic. As he wandered the streets he came across twins, who were abandoned by their parents. "I couldn't be a good dark magician, but I want to make their lives better!" He decided to retire from being an adventurer and raise these two girls as his own. And so, he raised his daughters, Corona and Selena. Teaching them black magic and enrolling them in a prestigious magician's academy. After learning more about magic, the girls return to see their father with some important news... They are S-rank Sages?! And they want to form a party with him?! A new adventure between a father and his daughters begin!

title.romaji: Boku no Kawaii Musume wa Futago no Kenja: Tokugi ga Debuff no Teihen Kuro Madoushi, Sodateta Futago no Musume ga S-Rank no Daikenja ni Natte Shimau

144919.description:
"I'm over 30, my job is great, and I have no plans to get married. Girls can live strong and independent lives!"

Miho is a dental hygienist with many boyfriends, Haruka is a model with a boy-toy boyfriend, and Kanuma is a construction worker with no man in her life. They are in their thirties, and while their work is fulfilling, their love lives are becoming more and more difficult... You will laugh because you know all about their problems... but it's great to see women who live by their own rules! It's the kind of story that will make you want to shout "I know, I know!"

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 愛だけ探していられない
届かぬ君へ 恋の詩を
title.romaji: Todokanu Kimi e Koi no Uta wo

144921.description:
"That coffee must be so bitter..."

Ever-cheerful, caring-to-a-fault Tsumugi Hina grows increasingly worried about one of her repeat customers. Calm and collected Satoko Tojo gets help discovering a drink that she'll enjoy from Tsumugi, her barista. As she starts to explore her likes and dislikes, something else begins to bloom between them.

A story about discovering that life doesn't have to be all bitter coffee and office work!

(Source: YURI HUB)

title.native: ルーム・フォー・ハニーズ

144922.description:
Mako is deeply, deeply in love with Asuka, her girlfriend. As they spend time together on a relaxed morning, she reflects on their past, and considers their future. An affectionate, domestic yuri romance that's warm and gentle like the summer's morning sun.

(Source: YURI HUB)

title.native: グッドモーニング・スウィーティー

144923.description:
"I will kiss you once for each basket you score," Shiki promised Hinami for a reward at Shiki's house the day after the game.

Does that means she's going to kiss me 15 times?

(Source: Number Nine, translated)

Note: Released at Comiket 97.

title.native: ごほうびにキスしてよ

144924.description:
After three years in jail, he will emerge with the seven strongest bloodlines under heaven, twelve peak professional skills, thirty-six sets of supreme martial arts, seventy-two strongest mystical techniques, and 108 top-level chaos mantras! But with his maxed out martial powers, it turns out his spirit animal is a pig?

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: I Return from the Heaven and Worlds

title.romaji: Wo Cong Zhu Tian Wan Jie Guilai

144925.description:
"Mr. Student Council President! You're a Hot Mess!": Yoji Suzumoto is the beloved student council president of Seifu High School. He is approachable, kind, and smart. The new student council member, Kaname Shirosaki, however, is scary and intimidating. No one would believe that after everybody goes home, Kaname is the doting lover and Yoji has the prickly cold shoulder! "Love Isn't a Difficult Thing": Yuji Nagato is the infamous school delinquent. But to Shikama, the rumors couldn't be more false. Yuji is just a laid-back guy who gets picked on by other delinquents. When all of the forces around him want him to end his friendship with Yuji, what will they do?...

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.english: Mr. Student Council President! You're a Hot Mess!
title.native: 乱れすぎです！生徒会長

144926.description:
Yuya Hanamaki is a university graduate who has to take over managing his grandpa's apartment building after a back injury. Reluctantly, Yuya begins his duties. And the first thing he must do is greet all of the tenants. When Yuya gets to room 3, he lets himself in, as advised by one of the other tenants, and out comes a familiar face from the piles of mess... Yuya has fond memories of growing up in the apartment building and meeting very nice people. But this Ikezawa is nothing like he remembers!

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

144927.description:
Yoon-Woo and Tae-Gyeom have been best friends since childhood, but Yoon-Woo is hiding a secret that could tear them apart–he’s an omega… and he’s in love with Tae-Gyeom.

When a traumatic event leads Tae-Gyeom to despise all omegas, Yoon-Woo is forced to keep his identity a secret. After struggling for years to avoid Tae-Gyeom, they both end up at the same college, and Yoon-Woo’s carefully guarded secret is in danger of being exposed…

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

144928.description:
Jeong-Hae has always wanted to live an ordinary life. But it’s hard to pay the bills when you’re deep in debt and barely scraping by working an honest, average job. One day, Jeong-Hae discovers that his brother is bringing in big bucks and suspects something dirty is going on, so he tails his brother…to a strip club full of male strippers?! When Jeong-Hae storms in to drag his brother out of the changing room, he has no idea that he’s about to get a hell of a new job that’s far from ordinary…and that the club’s charismatic number one stripper, Yu-Gon, is going to change his life.

(Source: Lezhin US)

144929.description:
Shortly after being brutally rejected by a guy he was interested in at a bar, Kim Tae-Hyeon was determined to build his body and started receiving personal training. But his personal trainer, Gi-Hyeok, is exactly his type...

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

144930.description:
He Mian, a college student who has social anxiety, clears his favorite game for the 100th time. Gareth, the devil of the game, accidentally transmigrates into the modern world where He Mian is. He Mian is determined to return the devil back to the game as soon as possible. In order to get rid of Gareth's pranks and entanglements, the two must collect magical artifacts from the game which have been scattered across the world.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.
synonyms: Lord Demon King Always Teases Me
게임 속 마왕이 자꾸 날 괴롭혀!

144931.description:
A thick layer of mist shrouds the world and turns people into zombie-like monsters. Without knowing its cause or the solution, the only way out is to sneak into the capital city built for the privileged. While struggling for survival, Hayeon, a talented biologist, finds out that his crush Myung Woon has something to do with the virus...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Notes: Includes 17 extra chapters.

144933.description:
Imagine how your life would change if everyone thought that having sex with you would bring them good luck. That is exactly what happens to one (lucky) boy...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: A live-action AV adaptation (HUNTB-219) was released on February 22nd, 2022.

144934.description:
My sister, Rain, is beautiful, smart, and nice. She's a perfect and lovely sister. But you'll never guess what I found in her diary.

(Source: Toomics)

144935.description:
16-year-old shut-in Yoruhiko's twin sister, Akane, ends up in a coma after getting into an accident. Not wanting to ruin her perfect attendance, Yoruhiko decides to continue her record by going to school in her place. But, in order to do so, he must disguise himself as her and attend an all-girls boarding school! How will former recluse Yoruhiko keep up his act when surrounded by his sister's friends and roommate?

(Source: Comikey)

title.english: I’m Cute Enough to Get Away with It!
title.native: かわいいからギリゆるせる

144939.description: A story about the sullen Aoba Suzuki and the rising star Kenshin Akasawa making their way into the world of MMA fighting.

144940.description:
Komine is an ordinary grade-school kid who is at the top of his class. And for good reason - after dying, this is actually his second run at life. Knowing everything from upcoming class subjects to future events, Komine naturally excels at whatever he does.

…and then there’s Sarara Miyano, Komine’s classmate. The last time he was in school, he was despised by her because of some foolish actions he took in the past. But now that he’s mentally older and wiser, maybe he can turn things around?
synonyms: Tsuyokute New Game na Love Comedy

title.native: つよくてニューゲームなラブコメ
title.romaji: Tsuyokute New Game na Love Kome

title.native: 怜央先輩は無気力甘い。
モテあそぶマチちゃん

144944.description:
The manga centers on Hanayo, an elderly woman whose husband of many years has only recently died. After finishing a Buddhist service for her husband, she finds herself walking out in town alone for the first time in a long time. She stumbles onto a cosmetics store, and meets a beautiful woman named Yoshiko Doujima, and falls in love at first sight. Hanayo had long given up on makeup after her husband nagged her about it, but putting some on with Yoshiko's help brightens her heart.

(Source: Anime News Network)

144946.description:
A boy lives in a floating town, where the poor scrape by and the rich live a sumptuous life, simply casting their garbage off the side, into the abyss. When he’s falsely accused of murder, though, his wrongful conviction leads to an unimaginable punishment—exile off the edge, with the rest of the trash. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has bred vicious monsters, and to travel the path to vengeance against those who cast him into Hell, a boy will have to become a warrior…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

144948.description:
It’s been a while since all androids have been outlawed. Soojung’s never been one for technology, let alone androids. So it’s a big surprise when her sister gets her a new job… and it’s to keep an eye on her illegal android. Soojung feels uncomfortable around him as it is. He’s weirdly too polite, has no emotion in his eyes, and he hasn’t even got a name. But what Soojung doesn’t know yet is that she’s going to change all that. And what’s more, this android is going to change her life too, in more ways than one…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

144949.description:
Kika Mifune, an elementary school girl, wanted to become like an anime villainess. Can she handle having 100 servants?

(Source: Niconico Seiga, translated)

title.native: 桔香ちゃんは悪役令嬢になりたい！
title.romaji: Kikka-chan wa Akuyaku Reijou ni Naritai!

144950.description:
The day before summer vacation, Minoru, a junior high boy who quit the baseball team, met a boy who was watching the team practice. Without thinking, Minoru asked, "Do you like watching baseball?" But the boy did not reply.

This is a series of stories by Nagashima Hiromi, a winner of the "Cakes Creator Contest," about Minoru, the boy, and the warm interaction between them and the people around them.

(Source: Cakes.mu, translated)

144951.description:
Sakiko, a PhD student working on a time machine, is contacted out of nowhere by her high school friend, Kaede, who she hasn't seen for seven years.

Note: Morning Magazine Monthly Award Honorable Mention June 2021
synonyms: Time jump with completely no deterioration transporter

title.native: 時間跳躍式完全無劣化転送装置
title.romaji: Jikan Chouyakushiki Kanzen Murekka Tensou Souchi

144952.description:
Is he like a cat? A dog? No, it's obviously a beast! In a small town where an incident of bloodshed suddenly occurred, Cha Na, a typical high school girl, met Yu Mu, a popular boy at school, who was suspected of being the perpetrator. As their relationship changed over time, the boy who seemed so gentle and kind at first gradually showed his true colors, and the truth behind the incidents were revealed.

(Source: Manman, translated)

144953.description:
Ling Yun, a cultivator, failed to overcome his trial, and his soul was cast into the body of Ling Yun, a loser in the current world who was just assassinated in the city. Faced with unknown enemies out to kill him, in a strange world that he knew nothing about, Ling Yun will cultivate his power, draw upon talismans, and refine potions and weapons to fight back against evil!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

144954.description: That boy is… a walking corpse! Sato-kun, who met an early demise in a traffic accident, came back to school as a zombie. That popular guy who'd light up the room, is now silent and expressionless and barely manages to trace the habits of his old life. Hozumi, a girl in his class, is worried for him. Experience this mysterious and youthful romance between a reticent zombie and a shy girl!

title.native: 佐藤くんが死んでから

144955.description:
College student Tomoya, dumped by his first love, gets drunk and passes out in the pouring rain, only to be found by cafe-owner Takawa. But...... at night, the cafe becomes a bar, where the (all male!) staff become lingerie-clad bunnies! Tomoya ends up working at the cafe, forced to become a bunny himself, and then even gets down and dirty with Takawa! This is a sweet-but-sexy love story between a cool, arrogant older man and an ordinary college student.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.english: The Wolf and His Little White Bunny
title.native: オオカミ男と白うさ少年
title.romaji: Ookami Otoko to Shiro Usa Shounen

144956.description:
A world where vampires and humans coexist. Ian, an ordinary human, thinks vampires who drink human blood are terrible, but he gets a part-time job that provides blood to vampires due to the high pay. Unlike Ian's prejudice, Raymond is a very gentlemanly and beautiful employer. Since he is no different from normal humans, Ian is getting more and more attracted to Raymond…

(Source: WebComics)

144957.description:
Faced with imminent defeat and certain death, would you choose to run – or continue to fight for a doomed world? When mysterious towers appear across the world, summoning monsters that prey on mankind, this is the choice presented to the Tower Walkers – adventurers with special powers to fight the monsters. On the brink of death, they can choose to use a “regression stone” to return to the past for a second chance, though this decision places them in a separate timeline forever. Stubborn Tower Walker Jae-Hwan rejects this choice, choosing to fight for the original timeline, and learning shocking secrets about the Tower along the way.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: หลังวันสิ้นโลก

144958.description:
"How is it? Sweet, right?"

One day on her shift as library assistant, Hinano finds ultra-popular ladies' man, Haruna Iori, sleeping amongst the stacks. Not only does he tease Hinano relentlessly, he also somehow ends up stealing her first kiss! Hinano decides to pretend it never happened and goes home -- only to find Haruna at her house, too? That's when Hinano's mother breaks the news to her: she'll be living with Haruna for the next six months! Hinano's heart is sure to beat out of her chest sharing a space with the free-spirited Haruna, whose advances only grow sweeter and sweeter!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: You Can Give Me My Reward Tonight
title.native: ごほうびは夜にちょうだい

144959.description:
China is a county with a deep history. This land has had many emperors, but only one "empress regent"...... and her name was "Wu Zetian." Set in China at the beginning of the Tang dynasty, this is the spectacular epic tale of a woman's harsh chaotic life as she went from a lowly court lady in the emperor's harem to an empress who built her own empire! This romantic historical piece is brought to you by the wonderful Ryo Kurashina and Takeshi Mine!

(Source: Group-Zero)

title.native: 世界女帝列伝 武則天

144960.description:
A high school student, Shuuyu Asai, who believes that "life is all about compromise" and pretends to be something he's not, has an unrequited crush on his best friend since childhood, the most beautiful girl in school, Unane Naraoka.

One day, while talking with Nona Kusunoki, a sub-heroine classmate who keeps to herself in the classroom, a casual joke leads to a relationship.

"...That's what I said, and I'm sticking to it." They each wanted a boyfriend and girlfriend, so they compromised with each other and became lovers?!

They decided on the rules of their relationship, and began to exchange messages throughout the night, discovering the cute side of each other during study sessions and dates at home. The lover's life that started from a compromise turned out to be surprisingly fun!?
synonyms: We can't be the protagonists, we start our lives as lovers from compromise.

144964.description: Masako Tachibana is married to Toshio Akagi, an earnest and honest civil servant. However, one day after 22 years of marriage, Toshio took his own life at home... Toshio was in the middle of a case where government land was sold at an unfair price, and was ordered to falsify official documents to cover up the names of those involved. The story follows Masako as she confronts the government in an attempt to learn the truth about her husband's death.

title.native: がんばりょんかぁ、マサコちゃん

144965.description:
An accident at the ski resort ruined her dream of becoming a ballet star. She fell into a coma, didn't have the courage to wake up because the world was too cruel for her. But still there is hope. The ones who truly love her brought her a new life. Again she stands and ready to pursue her dreams. This time, how will she tackle the difficulties of life? Will she meet her Prince Charming one day and lives happily like Cinderella in the fairy tale...

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Ta Liao Ren You Tou Xin

144966.description:
A fine woman with large breasts and tattoos all over her body. That's my mom, Taeko Miki, 31 years old. I'm Kenzou Miki, 16 years old, in my second year of high school. My mom gave birth to me when she was 15. I don't know my father. Mom raised me by herself. I don't want to do the same thing as my dad, who got my mom pregnant when she was still in school, and then abandoned her. My girlfriend is important to me, so I don't want her to go through the same thing as my mom... But lately it's been difficult to control myself. She's adorable, and I'm at the height of puberty... Me, my mom, and my girlfriend. And my girlfriend's brother. Why are my eyes blue? Why does she have cigarette burns on her back? And what is the relationship between my mom and her brother...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 傷つける様に愛し合いましょう

144967.description:
A normal college student is married to a rich hottie, and gets to enable a "life system." Whatever he chooses on the system will come true! Only kids make choices; adults want everything! See how the rich son-in-law counterattack on those who bully him and rise to the crown!

(Source: Webcomics)

144968.description:
Tang San reincarnated into the world where monsters dominate against humans, treating them as slaves. Witnessing the cruelty of the monsters, he trains to save the humans from eternal demise. Not only he vows to save humans, he has the important quest to find the reincarnated Xiao Wu

(Source: INKR)

144970.description:
Women in their twenties living together at a temple on a remote island!

Hina is a junior high school teacher who felt like she was not "cut out" for her job or life. Her toxic parents broke up her engagement and she couldn't take it anymore! She left her hometown for a remote island... where she ended up living in a shared-house with a group of women, each with her own history!

A free spirit with zero friends, a NEET young lady, and a mysterious divorced beauty......
A group of strange women who each lives in her own awkward way. A little bit of love! A life together!

(Source: Ura Sunday, translated)

title.native: かけこみ！シェアハウス

144972.description:
The hero Ledo and his companions have a mission: defeat the Demon Lord once and for all. Aina is a formidable fighter, taking down foes with only her fists and feet; Grace the wizard harnesses powerful magic to blast away enemies in their path. Meanwhile, Ledo faces an unexpected challenge in their quest: a big, fluffy cat has taken a liking to him, following the party wherever they go…and jumping into Ledo’s lap whenever it’s free, even in the heat of battle! Everyone knows you can’t just dump a cat off your lap in good conscience. If Ledo pushes this sweet kitty away while it’s happily making biscuits, will he be any better than the monsters he’s trying to fight? A swords and sorcery story for fans of cats and comedy!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

144975.description:
One man in the girls' dormitory. Surrounded by cute schoolgirls, I have sex every day! By chance, Eita becomes a caretaker of the girls' dormitory, which is forbidden to boys. On the first day, he is told that no one is using the bathroom at this hour, so he enters the "girls' bathroom," and the girl who appears there is his naked childhood friend, Momoka...!! He accidentally falls and dives into her boobs... Shit, are boobs really this soft!? Spontaneously, he sucks the pink nipples in front of him, and Momoka's pussy becomes wet... Is he going to put it in now!? The next morning, when he wakes up, a half-naked girl is sleeping next to him... This girls' dormitory is too erotic...!!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Released as 24 episodes and sold as 8 chapters.

144978.description:
Satsuki is a regular office worker with a little secret: dating his boss, Mr. Matsuri. Although they don't leave the office together, what makes the heart race more than knowing that your lover is waiting for you to go home together? One particular night, Satsuki is invited over to Mr. Matsuri's and is shocked to learn that his boss lives in a run-down, rickety, old apartment. Is there a reason why Mr. Matsuri lives here? That night, Satsuki has a dream from what looks like long ago in history... but it feels so real... a memory...? It surely isn't Satsuki's. So, whose...?

(Source: Futekiya)

144983.description:
Xiaosha was just an ordinary girl, until an accident forced her to live a completely different life. Will she be able to safely overcome this challenge?

(Source: Webtoon, translated)
synonyms: วุ่นรักสลับวิญญาณ

144984.description:
Xi Chun had hit rock bottom, until she received encouragement from the web-novel author Tai De. One day, on her way to see her idol, she accidentally ran into a vampire. She thought she'd escaped, until she found out that vampire is actually a senior at her school?? Xi Chun will have to try to live a normal life while living with a vampire...

(Source: Webtoon, translated)

144988.description:
Fang Qi, an alchemist in the modern world, time traveled to a new world ruled by monsters because of an accident during pill refining. He decided to use monsters as materials to refine pills. However, after he woke up, he found himself sitting on the bed like a blushing bride. The "bridegroom" he's waiting for turned out to be a little monster boy called Yuying, and then something really weird happened. The monster boy, always known as a sickly, teeny tiny little kid, suddenly transformed into an adult with really strong manhood.

(Source: Webnovel)

144989.description:
The thousands of strange and bizarre worlds gave birth to all kinds of amazing species. The honored heir of a famed Taoist family broke through numerous obstacles to compete with all the prodigies of the multiverse. He will drag down the high and mighty saints and dump them into the mire. He will witness the miracles of the universe, and fulfill his desire to gain immortality!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

144997.description:
Seonghoon Kang has been the cook’s helper at Jewelria, a third-rate hotel, for years, causing his self-esteem to plummet lower than his standing in the kitchen. However, he has a secret that makes him a cut above the rest… he can see the “memory” of an ingredient with just one touch! The sear of the kitchen may scorch the meek, but can this rookie chef survive the heat and prevail over the grueling struggles of life? Or should he just get out of the kitchen for good?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Youngest Chef From the 3rd Rate Hotel

title.english: Rookie Chef with the Magic Touch

144999.description:
Jung Hyunwoo is just an unlucky gamer barely making ends meet in the VR game "God Wars." He even ends up losing access to his game account due to a horrible accident and is forced to create a new character. In the process, he discovers that he has an ability that allows him to see hidden information in the game, which leads him to become a Grand Warlock. Now equipped with a mind-blowing skill and a legendary class, all that's left is for him to level up and go from zero to hero...

(Source: Tapas)
